## Survey

A versioned survey definition.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `id` | `string` | Stable id |
| `name` | `string` | Name |
| `version` | `number` | Latest published version |
| `questions` | `Question[]` | Questions of the latest version |

### Methods

#### update()

```ts
update(changes: { questions: Question[] }): Promise<void>
```

Publishes a new version.

#### versions()

```ts
versions(): Promise<number[]>
```

#### submissions()

```ts
submissions(options?: { since?: Date; version?: number }): AsyncIterable<Submission>
```

Iterates over submissions oldest first. Use it with `for await`; collecting into an Array<Submission> loads every page.

#### assign()

```ts
assign(options: { labels: Record<string, string> }): Promise<number>
```
